name: Shared-Entry Validator Hardening
goal: Make workspace-manager git.ts isSafeSharedEntry reject entries with a newline, carriage return, or leading/trailing whitespace, and add a bounding test, so addSharedResourceEntries cannot persist a smuggled multi-line or padded config entry.

tasks.name: Harden isSafeSharedEntry (reject control chars + surrounding whitespace)
tasks.description: In git.ts isSafeSharedEntry (:236-245) add two pure clauses before the final `return true;`: `if (entry !== entry.trim()) return false;` (leading/trailing ASCII whitespace) and `if (/[\x00-\x1f]/.test(entry)) return false;` (any ASCII control char incl. interior \n/\r/tab). No other change; the validator is the single gate for both the config write (addSharedResourceEntries) and the read-time relink (linkSharedResources). TDD: extend the reject test in git.test.ts (:181-188) bad array to add 'ok\nescape','a\rb',' models','models '; the existing clean-accept test (:157) is the over-rejection positive control. Rebuild the 3 dist bundles (validator is compiled in).

steps.description: RED: in git.test.ts extend the 'rejects unsafe entries and never writes them' test (:183) bad array to ['../escape','/abs','a*','trailing/','!neg','#comment','ok\nescape','a\rb',' models','models ']. Existing assertions (result.rejected==bad, result.added==[], readSharedResourceConfig(id)==[]) bound the fix; the 'appends valid entries' test (:157) with clean ['data/models','caches/vision'] is the positive control against over-rejection.

steps.expected: FAIL: current validator admits 'ok\nescape'/'a\rb'/' models'/'models ' -> they land in added not rejected; 'ok\nescape' writes two lines so readSharedResourceConfig is not [] and rejected != bad.

steps.description: GREEN: in git.ts isSafeSharedEntry, before `return true;`(:244), add `if (entry !== entry.trim()) return false;` then `if (/[\x00-\x1f]/.test(entry)) return false;`.

steps.expected: tsc clean + 3 dist bundles written; no errors
